_expect_channel_id_why: Finance % Decoded. Checked by assert_channel() before any write. Every write in reset_packaging.py resolves its target with mine=True, so this file's contents land on whatever channel YT_REFRESH_TOKEN authenticates as — and fix_channel_meta() would overwrite that channel's keywords and country with the Islamic-finance list below. This repo now runs a second channel (HELD BY FAITH, UCh0tKIGR5Ns3Wvoai__txdg, config in heldbyfaith/), so a swapped secret is a real path to writing this config onto the wrong channel. Read-only runs warn; writes abort.

playlists._why: Fifth pass, 2026-08-08. This is the playlist linked from the channel description AND from the footer of every video description, so it is the channel's main non-feed surface. It held 17 of 24 public Shorts — the seven most recent uploads were never added, which means every Short published since the reset has had no Browse or Suggested path at all once its 72-hour feed test ended. Purely additive sync: nothing is removed or reordered, so this is safe to run against videos still inside their test. Membership is not packaging — it changes no title, description or tag the feed is measuring.

The general rule this establishes: the ONLY packaging lever with a real expected return is the pre-publish one.

protected._why: Guard rail. reset_packaging.py refuses to touch any id in this list. These are the channel's proven winners; their packaging is the reference, not the problem.

channel._why: youtube_channel_about returned keywords: [] — the channel had no channel-level keywords at all. These are a weak signal next to per-video metadata, but they are one of the few inputs YouTube uses to decide which topic cluster a channel belongs to, and an empty field gives it nothing. Costs nothing and cannot cannibalise anything. Written via brandingSettings, fetched-then-mutated so the rest of the branding survives.
channel._country_why: Channel is based in the UAE; target audience is UK and US. brandingSettings.country states where the channel is based - it is not an audience-targeting lever and does not gate who gets served the Shorts feed, so an accurate AE costs nothing in UK/US reach. It was empty before, which is the only real defect. Reach to UK/US is carried by defaultLanguage=en (already set on every upload) and watch signals, not by this field.
